title: Meditative+ balance changes III
notes: R1828000: API Key Fishing's Radiant face adds a Radiant copy, at 4% (Embiggened 10%); R1828001: AI Slop fuses (1) Cost AI generated cards; R1828002: KY's Empty Notebook shuffles 3 random KY cards into your deck; R1828003: Shrinking Felinor is 9/9 (18/18), both faces shrinking 3/3 into a base body; Jungle Loser has Can't attack and a 100% end-of-turn attack; Bauble Bubble has Brittle 1, BOOM! Big Max Crater, Book Worm the Plague tag; Felinor Fuser is 1/1 (2/2); Supply Drop is renamed Jlockeed's Supply Drop. plays: the families classify's stage 2 names in its unforced games with these cards (pools they join or leave, Devin Bot's 1/1 pool and Permanent Upperclassman's (4) Cost pool among them, and the views those games show). rule: no rule changes; stage 2 finds divergences that name no card, a library view ordered by name putting the renamed Jlockeed's Supply Drop in a new place and a fused BOOM! Big Max whose Crater Lock outlasts it, so the claim matches classify (R1370000).

player.title: Meditative+ balance changes III
balance: Shrinking Felinor is 9/9, down from 9/11, and 18/18 on its Radiant face, down from 18/22.
Shrinking Felinor's Radiant face shrinks by 3/3, up from 2/3.
Felinor Fuser is 1/1, down from 3/3, and 2/2 on its Radiant face, down from 6/6.
API Key Fishing's Radiant face has a 4% chance, down from 5%, and 10% Embiggened, down from 12%.
Jungle Loser attacks at the end of every turn of yours, up from a 25% chance (50% on its Radiant face).
changes: AI Slop fuses only (1) Cost AI generated cards.
KY's Empty Notebook shuffles 3 random KY cards into your deck instead of drawing, Radiant ones on its Radiant face.
API Key Fishing's Radiant face adds a Radiant API Key Fishing to your hand.
Shrinking Felinor's Radiant face summons a base Shrinking Felinor.
Book Worm is a Plague card.
Devin Bot can summon Felinor Fuser, now a 1/1.
text: Supply Drop is renamed Jlockeed's Supply Drop.
